params.name: fit_gap
params.comment: per side, housing cavity over the plate edges; 0.1 to 0.5 mm

params.name: x_half
params.comment: plate / housing inner half-width (x = -x_half back ... +x_half front); 45 to 70 mm

params.name: plate_bot
params.comment: world y of the mount plate's bottom edge (from the clutch/tray layout); fixed by feed_unit.py

params.name: plate_top
params.comment: world y of the mount plate's top edge (from the standoffs/guard); fixed by feed_unit.py

params.name: w_shell0
params.comment: W of the housing's open rim on the plate edges (plate outer face - lap); fixed by feed_unit.py

params.name: cap_cut
params.comment: W where the end cap starts and the hood ends; 200 to 260 mm (each part must fit a MK3S bed)

params.name: r_long
params.comment: outer radius of the long edges, also the 45-degree top-front chamfer's leg; 8 to 15 mm

params.name: r_bottom
params.comment: outer radius of the two bottom long edges; 6 to 10 mm

params.name: band_y
params.comment: world y of the bottom of the hood's control strip; -40 to -10 mm

params.name: lap
params.comment: how far the hood's outer skin runs on over the end cap's stepped top; 5 to 12 mm

params.name: lap_t
params.comment: thickness of that lapped skin; 0.8 to 1.5 mm (less than panel_t)

params.name: chamfer_in
params.comment: inside legs of the housing's top 45-degree chamfers (derived)
